title: Delivery receipt acknowledgement
description: Body of the 200 response to POST /v1/receipts (plan 15.3, 16.2): the Mac recorded the receipt, or had recorded the same receipt_id with the same body before (duplicate true, nothing changed). queue_entry_id and entry_state are always present: both null for an item fetched from the catalog without a queue entry, and both set for a receipt that names one (the server sets the entry's state exactly when the receipt names an entry; the if/then/else below). entry_state is the queue entry's state after this receipt, which never moves backwards (a late downloaded_to_phone after imported_into_sylvia leaves it imported). Moved from the OpenAPI document's inline components/schemas/ReceiptAck at the M0 final fix (contracts review R1-06), unchanged; on 20 October 2026, before v1's first release (Contracts/README.md, Versioning), the pairing of queue_entry_id and entry_state, which the inline schema had left implicit, was added (M0 final review round 2, contracts R2-05).

queue_entry_id.description: The device-inbox entry the receipt was for, or null for a catalog download without a queue entry.

entry_state.description: The queue entry's state after this receipt; null for a catalog download without a queue entry.

duplicate.description: True when this receipt_id was already recorded with the same body.
